input: Any commit that modifies /moves/queen_d8.text must also be co-signed by pawn_c7 and king_e8 and must be signed by at least fifteen of the sixteen Black agents' keys including queen_d8's own, so that queen_d8's repeated amnesia, panic, and greed moves can never be accepted without near-unanimous agreement.
response: always([+modifies(/moves/queen_d8.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/pawn_c7.id)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/queen_d8.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/king_e8.id)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/queen_d8.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/queen_d8.id)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/queen_d8.text) -threshold("15", /team/pieces)] false)
